author: Krishna Dhamala
review_text: Very disappointed with eSewa’s service lately. The server is frequently down, making it nearly impossible to complete urgent transactions on time. The app often logs out automatically without any reason, and logging back in becomes a frustrating task. Sometimes, it takes multiple attempts just to access the account, which wastes both time and energy. This is especially inconvenient during peak hours or when trying to pay bills or transfer money quickly. Need Improved better
